title: ProGPU, cadcodec, and cross-peer route-boundary refresh
mode: primary-source repository documentation and issue-timeline review; plan-only update
scope: Screen newly surfaced open-source CAD repositories for independent DWG/DXF parser or ACIS semantic evidence
Bind renderer observations to their actual file-format reader lineage and route
Refresh current ACadSharp issue leads and route each to an existing local finding/subplan without promoting peer reports into local defects

method.kind: Read-only review of primary GitHub repositories, project documentation, and issue discussions
method.limitations: ProGPU, cadcodec, and issue sources are mutable/report-authored web sources. ProGPU's renderer/source call path and ACIS decoder were not inspected or executed; cadcodec's source diff against opencadcodec was not inspected. Issue attachments and claimed third-party reproductions were not downloaded or independently reproduced. No claim of exhaustive discovery is made.

sources.observed: The architecture document assigns CAD file-format object-model ownership to ACadSharp and presentation/rendering to ProGPU. A separate browser sample documents netDxf.netstandard 2.4.0 as a parser assembly. The DXF guide describes a renderer-side SAT/SAB scan including a tagless fixed-layout fallback and projects extracted edges to line segments. Exact current call paths, parser use, ACIS grammar, and runtime behavior were not verified.

GitHub identifies compscientific/cadcodec as forked from HakanSeven12/opencadcodec. Its README identifies the crate/API as acadrust 0.5.5 and repeats broad feature/version claims. No release is listed on the reviewed repository page. The code diff and ACIS module lineage were not audited.

sources.revision: Open GitHub issue pages and Autodesk HATCH reference, reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: Issue #1172 remains a private-input AC1032 missing-INSERT report with a possible TableEntity inheritance/count confound raised in discussion, not a proven resolution. #1253's follow-up comment reports group 47 on derived-boundary HATCH records (path flag 92=7), conflicting with the initial zero-pixel-size omission claim; the strict-consumer condition remains unresolved. #1261 is a private R2009 GEODATA class-version-tail report and spec-comparison lead. #1277 reports native AUDIT failures for standalone annotative MLeader context objects without shareable DWG inputs.

assessment.planImpact: Classifies cadcodec as an ACadRust/opencadcodec-family fork pending source-diff review; classifies ProGPU as a conditional downstream renderer with route-dependent ACadSharp or netDxf parser lineage and unverified edge-projection claims; refreshes ACadSharp #1172/#1253/#1261/#1277 as non-promoting leads attached to existing PAR-49, 7AH/7Z, PAR-119/7BP, and PAR-07/S8 work. No parser candidate, local finding, implementation subplan, dependency, fixture, test, peer run, support promotion, or J-item transition is added.

implementationReadyChecks: Do not admit a peer route based on repository description, version matrix, fork count, or renderer output; bind exact source commit and effective parser entry point first.

Treat ProGPU's ACIS edge projection as renderer-only evidence unless source audit and independent expected values establish the exact narrower route; it cannot prove body completeness, topology, volume, or B-rep semantics.

Count cadcodec with opencadcodec/ACadRust unless a source-level delta is identified and independently tested for a named behavior; separately audit any ACIS parser module before claiming implementation independence.
Route ACadSharp #1172 to exact runtime type/handle/owner identity and diagnostic checks; do not rely on base-class INSERT counts.
Keep #1253 HATCH group-47 presence unresolved; use generated factor-isolated profiles, exact output ordering, and a pinned strict consumer before changing writer behavior.
Keep #1261 on the ODA-backed GEODATA class-version path and #1277 on standalone MLeader context; neither private issue report authorizes peer-derived wire-format changes.
Preserve locally generated scratch controls only, focused fast tests per changed slice, no routine peer runtime, no external committed drawing, and all six J items as DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
